name: Create a service token
description: Create a service token Generates a new service token. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/service_tokens
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/service_tokens
Generates a new service token. **Note:** This is the only time you can get the Client Secret. If you lose the Client Secret, you will have to rotate the Client Secret or create a new service token.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a service token
description: Delete a service token Deletes a service token. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/service_tokens/{service_token_id}

name: Get a service token
description: Get a service token Fetches a single service token. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/service_tokens/{service_token_id}

name: List service tokens
description: List service tokens Lists all service tokens. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/service_tokens
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/service_tokens
Lists all service tokens.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: name (query); search (query); page (query); per_page (query)

name: Refresh a service token
description: Refresh a service token Refreshes the expiration of a service token. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/service_tokens/{service_token_id}/refresh
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/service_tokens/{service_token_id}/refresh
Refreshes the expiration of a service token.
Required: service_token_id (path); account_id (path)

name: Rotate a service token
description: Rotate a service token Generates a new Client Secret for a service token and revokes the old one. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/service_tokens/{service_token_id}/rotate
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/service_tokens/{service_token_id}/rotate
Generates a new Client Secret for a service token and revokes the old one.
Required: service_token_id (path); account_id (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Update a service token
description: Update a service token Updates a configured service token. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/service_tokens/{service_token_id}
